name: ai-teams
description: Multi-agent task orchestration for Claude Code agents.

scripts.dev:agent:alice: EMPLOYEE_ID=alice EMPLOYEE_NAME=Alice RUNNER_MODE=claude DEFAULT_WORKSPACE=$PWD pnpm --filter @csdwd/ai-teams-agent dev
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,alice,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:agent:alice" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.start:agent:alice: EMPLOYEE_ID=alice EMPLOYEE_NAME=Alice RUNNER_MODE=claude DEFAULT_WORKSPACE=$PWD pnpm --filter @csdwd/ai-teams-agent start
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n server,alice,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm start:server" "pnpm start:agent:alice" "pnpm start:web"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ai-teams/shared build && pnpm --filter @csdwd/ai-teams-server build && pnpm --filter @ai-teams/web build && cp -r docs-site apps/server/dist/web/docs-site && pnpm --filter @csdwd/ai-teams-agent build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ai-teams/shared build && pnpm --filter @csdwd/ai-teams-server exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @csdwd/ai-teams-agent exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @ai-teams/web exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ai-teams/shared build && pnpm --filter @csdwd/ai-teams-server build && vitest run
